pr_title: *: use global auto analyze ID in order to kill auto analyze globally
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #34076

Problem Summary:
Currently the ID of auto analyze is fixed, which is incompatible with global kill feature.

### What is changed and how it works?

Use global auto analyze ID(serverID + fixed auto analyze ID). In this way we can support killing auto analyze globally(i.e., forward kill command to the instance running auto analyze).

issue_context.title: support killing auto analyze globally
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently the ID of auto analyze, which is displayed in `show processlist`, is fixed. In this way we need to login the instance which runs auto analyze and execute the kill command. We need to make the ID of auto analyze compatible with global kill.
